name: OXB
recent: Oxford Innotech Berhad 最新季度（截至2026年6月30日）营收与净利同比大幅增长，净利同比增162.5%。2026年9月至10月期间，多名董事及主要股东在公开市场买卖公司股份，其中独立非执行董事 Khoo Lay Tatt 于10月27日以每股0.610令吉减持20万股。
notable: 最新季度（截至2026年6月30日）营收同比增长43.7%，净利同比增长162.5%。
2026年9月10日至14日，执行董事 Oh Yen San、董事经理 Ng Thean Gin 及执行董事 Lee Lai Chan 在公开市场增持股份。
2026年10月27日，独立非执行董事 Khoo Lay Tatt 以每股0.610令吉减持20万股。
risks: 独立非执行董事 Khoo Lay Tatt 于2026年10月27日以每股0.610令吉减持20万股。
董事及主要股东在2026年9月至10月期间有多笔股份交易，包括在闭门期内的交易意向及实际交易。
earnings: 截至2026年6月30日季度，营收为2454.7万令吉，环比增37.7%，同比增43.7%；净利为415.5万令吉，环比增27.7%，同比增162.5%；净利率为16.9%，上一季度为18.2%。

recent_en: Oxford Innotech Berhad reported strong year-on-year growth in revenue and net profit for the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, with net profit up 162.5% YoY. Between September and October 2026, several directors and substantial shareholders traded shares in the open market, including Independent Non-Executive Director Khoo Lay Tatt disposing 200,000 shares at RM0.610 each on 27 October.
notable_en: Latest quarter ended 30 June 2026 saw revenue grow 43.7% YoY and net profit grow 162.5% YoY.
Between 10 and 14 September 2026, Executive Director Oh Yen San, Managing Director Ng Thean Gin and Executive Director Lee Lai Chan acquired shares in the open market.
On 27 October 2026, Independent Non-Executive Director Khoo Lay Tatt disposed 200,000 shares at RM0.610 each.
risks_en: Independent Non-Executive Director Khoo Lay Tatt disposed 200,000 shares at RM0.610 each on 27 October 2026.
Multiple share transactions by directors and substantial shareholders occurred between September and October 2026, including intentions to deal and actual dealings during the closed period.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM24.547 million, up 37.7% QoQ and 43.7% YoY; net profit was RM4.155 million, up 27.7% QoQ and 162.5% YoY; net margin was 16.9% versus 18.2% in the previous quarter.
